chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu Assuero jix gɨ'kora' dɨr gu India bɨɨx ka'm gu Etiopiia bhaan chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv oidha' gɨ'.
Na mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu vaik oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' tu duukam ua'tulhdhidha' vupui bhaan gu kavɨk gu Persia gu Media gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' oidha' gɨ'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gɨ'x bhai' mui'x gu tanoolh chamaam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' kɨɨv gu tanoolh naadat u'uu pai' gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali' gu ñi'ook gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't jix toja gu vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ñakaabma' jix toja jodai; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bhaan jodai na jix tuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i jix uam jodai jix jai' suudai' u'va vaak ja'tkam jurtu'nka' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ka't bhaan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; na soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu vaak; na bhaan aagak maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Basti gu u'vɨ gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kua' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x suudai' u'va jix aa'ñdhix gu Meumaan gu Bista gu arbona gu Bigta gu Abagta gu Setar gu Karkas kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx kuruun na ba' gu ja'tkam chiñia'; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Basti cham gu gɨ'kora' gu novɨ; gio ba' bhaam gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt jix jai' daak.
Na gu' tɨtda:―¿Jax jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mamatdagɨm jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx bɨx jix bhai'x ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mi'p ju'ñdharan gu Karsena gu Setar gu Admata gu Tarsis gu Meres gu Marsena gu Memukaan kɨɨv chiñia' gu Persia gu Media jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' dharka' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba'.
Na gu' gu Kuee ka't duñia' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Basti na gu' cham ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu novɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Memukaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' uañi'ñ gu Basti gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam cham tu'x jai'ch bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx jix duñia' bɨpna' bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero jix aa'ñdhix vupui bhaan gu Basti cham suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Jawatan gu Persia gu Media gu ñi'ook bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix jai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam vupui bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Persia gu Media cham ka't bhaan; na cham gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu gɨ'kora' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't tutkɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't naak bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix gɨ' bɨx gu u'vɨ nɨidhat bɨpna' dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Memukaan.
Na gu' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' jurtu'nka' gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' bham bɨx gu chio'ñ jum duu gu Jawatan gu vaak; gio ba' dhi' bhaan nɨɨn gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x tu' daak gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero tɨ'ñcho gu Basti ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨx jix bhai' gu Susaan gu vaak gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu egai gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Basti; gio ba' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Judiio gu Susaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Mardokêo gu mar gu Jair gu mar gu Simi gu mar gu Kis gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Jekôniias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhaan gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu adassa gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham ga'ra' gu taat tu' gu naan; gio ba' ka't duñia' jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu taat gu naan jix koko' gu Mardokêo ka't jix duñia' mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Sukedioo na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' mumua'da' gu Susaan gu egai ka't gio gu Ester na ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu egai jix nukadham gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu jix maa gio kɨɨv gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tutkɨ gu vaak gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Ester cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Mardokêo ka't jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Mardokêo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan naadat gu vaak gu u'vɨ maachim gu ñi'ook gu Ester gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Na gu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix ai gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero dhi' tu' masaa'n jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' masaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook masaa'n bɨɨx tu'x gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx chɨtda na ba' jix ai bɨɨx gu vaak gu u'vɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xumai gu xibh gu vaak gookim gu u'vɨ gu Saasgas gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' ka't mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu Abiail gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mardokêo ka't jix duñia' mar u'vɨ na ba' jix ai gu gɨ'kora' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu egai gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Ester nɨidhidha' bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Ester gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Tebet oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester bhaan bɨx gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan bɨx; gio ba' jix dhaas kuruun vaak ja'tkam mo'o tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Basti.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' tu duukam gu Ester; gio ba' oidha' gɨ' tu' jix duu jix maa jurtu'nka' vaak ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gookim jix duñia' gu Mardokêo ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Ester bhaan ga'ra' jix duñia' gu Mardokêo cham ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Ester jix duñia' chɨtda gu Mardokêo na ja'p na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh kua' gu Mardokêo daakat ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bigtaan gu Teres gook gu gɨ'kora' ki'ñgob gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mardokêo gu Ester gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Mardokêo.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bakia' dhuu; na ba' ba'k jix bɨɨx duu; mi' dhɨr ua'na u'uan tu'x vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo jix dhaas bhaan bɨx chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.
Na gu' bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi'p ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Amaan na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Mardokêo tu'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi'p ki'ñgob gui'p gu Mardokêo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu tanoolh dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo; na gu' tu' ka't jix duñia' ka't gu Judiio.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Amaan gu Mardokêo tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix bhuup daak.

Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Mardokêo; na tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Mardokêo; mi' dhɨr gu Amaan cham tu' duu bɨx gu Judiios ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu ja'tkam gu Mardokêo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu Nisaan oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero ka't jix duñia' gu Pur dhi' vupui bhaan gu Amaan gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix buus gu ñi'ook gu Adar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu ja'tkam cham ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' cham jupaabkamu'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't; gio ba' tu' jix duu mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu noobh na ba' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix maa gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo bhaamki'ñdha' gu Judiios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ba' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' xoi'kam tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mɨmɨim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' maa'n ka't ua'nak jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Amaan chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' mi'p bhaan oidha' gɨ' chiñia' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' bhaan gu'p gu ja'tkam bhaan nɨɨn; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero ka't ua'nak bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix duñia' bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' cham tu' duu kooda' bɨx gu Judiios dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Adar na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'nak koi gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' moor jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't jix maa gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan mi'p i'i kiicham gu Susaan ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mardokêo bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ maatai ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jiiñkɨk bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' oidha' gɨ' pai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kmarak gu Judiios jix gɨ' suanda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' maatai ka't mui'x.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' bhañ jajannulhi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook kutun gu Mardokêo jix duñia' bhaan; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ester jup tɨɨt gu Atak maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu Mardokêo bɨɨx maachim gu ñi'ook ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Atak gu Mardokêo ɨrban kiicham ka't vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Mardokêo gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jix toja jodai gu Amaan ka't tu ñi'ook jix duu na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judiios na ba' cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' jix maa gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'p ka't jix duñia' jix maa gu Susaan na ba' bhaai'n gu ñi'ook gu Ester gu ñi'ook jum duu gu gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Atak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester gu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ester gu Atak jix aa'ñdhix a'ga gu Mardokêo.

Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ba'k gu gɨ'kora' naadat cham tɨɨgim ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' koi; gio ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix uam jodai ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duñia' mɨmɨim na ba' baakɨi gu gɨ'kora' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Mardokêo gu ñi'ook gu Ester.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Mardokêo tu ñi'ook gu Ester; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Judiios.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Judiios baasɨ'n; gu' tu' gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' na ba' dhi' gu tas tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester tu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judiios bakia' gu Susaan tu' cham tu' vaik gu tanoolh gu tukaa' tu' gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu' gio bɨɨx ba'k gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' ka't gu Mardokêo tu' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Ester.

Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam jix dhaas naadat gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' daakat vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester ka't naadat nɨidhidha' gu vupui; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Ester gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Kuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' maa'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨmɨim gu Amaan na ba' duñia' gu Ester tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan gu Ester.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va; gio ba' tu' ka't gu Kuaal gu Aunkue ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ester; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan; gio ba' gu xibh jurtu'nka' gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu Amaan mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; gu' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Mardokêo ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' cham jix búup tu' oidha' bhaan jiim pai' jix bhuup bhaan gu Mardokêo daak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amaan suudai' u'va gu vaak bhañ tu' jix ai gu Seres gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' namkɨm gu ma'nkam bɨx tu'x bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't bɨɨx ka't bhaan chiñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amaan; gio ba' gio gu Ester jix duu jix ai bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu xibh jix duñia' amuub bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' bɨx dhi' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo daakat ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Seres gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' xoi'kam mambhɨɨx gu xibh tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Mardokêo; mi' dhɨr ba'k bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu vupui gu Amaan tu' jix duu.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' u'uan tu'x; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ua'nak gu Mardokêo ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bigtan gu Teres gook gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham ki'ñgob gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Mardokêo dhi' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' chɨkka naadat gu Amaan ka't tɨbiap naadat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' na ba' a'ga gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Mardokêo ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Amaan naadat; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Amaan gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook nɨidhat tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kavaayo gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kuruun vaak ja'tkam jix duñia' mo'o.

Jano' ba' jix maa tɨi'chu' kavaayo gu novɨ oi'ñdha' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' ñiata mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' kavaayo ɨrban kiicham vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ tɨi'chu' kavaayo na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Mardokêo ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu' bɨx tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Amaan jix bhɨɨ tɨi'chu' kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mardokêo kavaayo ɨrban kiicham tu' vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Mardokêo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan ka't gu vaak iiñat mo'o.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amaan gu Seres gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't; gio ba' gui'p mamatdagɨm gu Seres gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Si gu kai' gu Judiios gu Mardokêo vupui bhaan kua'da' cham; jano' ba' va'k tɨɨda' vupui bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bhaan jix ai gu Amaan gu Ester ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan i'i bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester.
Ba' jix aa' gio gook gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu Kuaal gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester tu' gu Kuaal gu Aunkue ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' koko'kam; gio ba' tu' na ba' tu duukam xoi'kam bhaamki'ñdha' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester; gio ba' gu Kuieen duukat tu' gu i'ii'ñ na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Amaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va i'iich ka't u'uu pai' gu vaak; gio ba' gu Amaan na ba' gu Ester gu oidha'; na gu' jix ñi' ka't na ba' cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' u'uu pai' gu vaak suudai' u'va gu Amaan ka't bhaan dhim ka't gu Ester; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gio na ba' kua' gu vaak na ja'p dhi' gu ñi'ook jix buus gu chin gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu Amaan ka't jix bhaan dhaas.

Ba' jix aa' gu arbona maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gio mambhɨɨx jix duñia' jix duu gu Amaan na ba' gu Mardokêo ka't tu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Mardokêo; gio ba' daak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester gu vaak gu Amaan bhaamki'ñdha' gu Judiios; na gu' gu Mardokêo suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na gu' gu Ester gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu Amaan jix maa gu Mardokêo; gio ba' gu Ester jix dhaas gu Mardokêo bhaan gu vaak gu Amaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester ñiokda' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨt joi'ndam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Amaan gu Agageo ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judiios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester jix uam jodai gu Ester jix búup jix dhaas tɨɨt vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu vupui ka't ua'nak na ba' gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo ua'na na ba' cham tu' duu gu Judiios bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' chajaañ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester gu Mardokêo gu Judiio; na gu' tu' jix maa gu Ester gu vaak gu Amaan jix duñia' na gu' gu novɨ bhaan gu Judiios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios na ja'p xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu'p ua'ñxidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham na ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mɨmɨim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' vaik gu Sibaan; gio ba' ua'na jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Mardokêo gu Judiios gu ñi'ook chiñia' oidha' gɨ' ka't dɨr gu India bɨɨx ka'm gu Etiopiia chamaam oidha' gɨ'; mi' dhɨr pai' gɨ' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' nɨɨn gu Judiios gio jurtu'nka' gu'p nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' bhañ jix duñia' kavaayo gɨ' kavɨk gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu Judiios mi'p bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' cham tu' duu kooda' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' bhaan a'aalh gu u'vɨ na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Adar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'p ka't jix maa jir bɨx bhai' oidha' gɨ' na ba' jum duu bɨx gu ja'tkam chɨtda gu Judiios na ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ba' obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam moor gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ka't gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Mardokêo vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja kuruun jix uam jodai ñakaabma'; gio ba' kiicham gu Susaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Judiios chooto'n gu tasi' bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat.

Jano' ba' oidha' gɨ' kiicham pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judiios chooto'n bhai' ñi'ook gu tanoolh; na gu' mui'x gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Judiios na gu' choo'n gu Judiios ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Adar gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tanoolh obhɨɨ'ñ gu Judiios ka't; na gu' gu Judiios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Judiios jum daa'ñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan cham bhai'; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak jix dhaas vupui bhaan na gu' choo'n ka't bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' oidha' gɨ' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judiios; na gu' choo'n gu Mardokêo ka't bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu Mardokêo ka't jix gɨ' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oidha' gɨ'; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu Mardokêo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kuchii jai'chdhɨlhia'; gio ba' tu' jix duu obhɨɨ'ñ aagak.
Jano' ba' gu Susaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' mu'aa gu Judiios gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu Porsandata gu Dalpoon gu Aspata.
Jano' ba' gu Porata gu Aaliia gu Aridata.
Jano' ba' gu Parmasta gu Arisai gu Aridai gu Baisata.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata bhaamki'ñdha' gu Judiios; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh suudai' u'va jix duñia' koko'kam gu Susaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester; gio ba' gu Susaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' jix koi gu Judiios gu chichio'ñ mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kuaal tu' ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gio gu xibh gu Judiios gu Susaan xoi'kam jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maa gu Susaan jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan.
Jano' ba' gu Judiios mi'p gu Susaan jum daa'ñ gio gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adar mu'aa gu Susaan vaik gu chichio'ñ; gu' cham gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios mi'p oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gio jum daa'ñ jix dhaas gu oidha' chooto'n jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ mu'aa jixchamaam jix bhai'x; gu' cham gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adar ka't dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu gu tanoolh bhai' ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Judiios mi'p gu Susaan jum daa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh xoi'kam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios cham vaak jodai xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu Adar gu tanoolh bhai' ñi'ook jix bhai' gu tanoolh tɨip maa'n.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu Mardokêo dhi' tu'x bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judiios mi'p bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Adar oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Judiios chooto'n jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ɨlhdha' bhai' ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bhai'; na gu tanoolh tɨip maa'n bia'.
Jano' ba' gu Judiios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' bhaan kua'da' ua'na gu Mardokêo.
Na gu' na gu' gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo bhaamki'ñdha' bɨx gu Judiios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Judiios na ba' cham tu' duu gu Pur na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Gu' gu' na ja'p gu Ester suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai'x bhaan gu Judiios bhaan mo'o; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tɨɨt dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pur; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios bhaan gu kai' bhaan bɨx cham ka't bhaan dhi' ja'tkam gook gu tanoolh bhaan ua'nak jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gook gu tanoolh jix duu chɨ'ñchoka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam ja'tkam vaak oidha' gɨ' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim cham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judiios chɨ'ñchoka' cham gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu Abiail gu Mardokêo gu Judiio gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx na ba' dhi' gookim gu ñi'ook gu Purim.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Mardokêo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judiios chamaam oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim miil bhaan ka't gu Mardokêo gu Judiio gu Ester na ja'p jix duñia' bhaan gu kai' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ester gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Purim ua'na u'uan.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki'ñdha' bhaan gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mardokêo bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu Persia.

Na gu' na gu' gu Mardokêo gu Judiio ka't gook mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Assuero jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judiios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam xoi'kam gu ja'tkam a'gi'ñchu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨx gu kai'.
